title: Rice and Peas
subtitle: jamaican coconut rice with kidney beans
excerpt: Rice and peas is a Jamaican staple of long-grain rice cooked in coconut milk with kidney beans, thyme and a whole scotch bonnet for gentle background heat. Serves 4 as a side.
sourceNotes: Rice and peas is Sunday food across Jamaica, eaten with jerk chicken, oxtail or curry goat. Despite the name, it uses kidney beans, not peas, reflecting the dish's Jamaican name for the ingredient.

glossaryTerms.definition: A Jamaican staple of rice cooked in coconut milk with kidney beans and thyme.
Creamy liquid pressed from grated coconut flesh, used to enrich rice and curries.

content.text: which gives the finished rice a faintly sweet, rich flavour that works perfectly alongside spicy main dishes. The scotch bonnet floats in whole during cooking; it adds warmth without the fierce heat of a split or chopped chilli.

The key is getting the liquid ratio right and not lifting the lid while the rice cooks. Once the liquid is absorbed, the rice steams in the trapped heat for 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork rather than a spoon to keep the grains separate.

items.prepNote: kept whole and removed before serving

content.text: Put the coconut milk, water, garlic, thyme, spring onion and whole scotch bonnet in the large saucepan. Bring to a gentle simmer.
Add the drained kidney beans and stir. Season the liquid well before adding the rice.
Add the rinsed rice and stir once. Bring to a simmer, then reduce the heat to very low. Cover with a tight-fitting lid.
Cook for 20 minutes without lifting the lid. After 20 minutes, check that the liquid is absorbed. If not, replace the lid and cook for 3 more minutes.
Remove from the heat. Leave the lid on and rest for 5 minutes. Remove the scotch bonnet, thyme and spring onion. Fluff with a fork and serve.

attrs.problem: The rice is catching and burning on the bottom.
attrs.solution: The heat was too high. Use the lowest setting on your hob. A heat diffuser can help on gas hobs that do not reduce very low.

attrs.problem: The rice is still hard after 20 minutes.
attrs.solution: Add 50ml more water, replace the lid and cook for another 5 minutes. Long-grain rice can vary in how much liquid it absorbs.

attrs.problem: The scotch bonnet burst during cooking.
attrs.solution: This makes the rice very spicy. Keep the bonnet whole and intact. If it bursts, remove it immediately and taste the rice for heat level.

content.text: Rice and peas is Sunday lunch food in Jamaica. Every family has their own method and their own view on the correct ratio of beans to rice. It appears on every Caribbean restaurant menu in the UK alongside jerk chicken or oxtail stew. It is deeply practical comfort food.
